items.title: Beximco Pharma recommends highest dividend since 2020
items.description: Beximco Pharmaceuticals has recommended a 60 percent cash dividend for the financial year ended June 30, 2026, the highest since at least 2020.

items.title: ACI’s loss widens for fourth straight year
items.description: Advanced Chemical Industries (ACI), one of Bangladesh’s largest conglomerates, reported losses for the fourth consecutive year in FY2025-26, as inflationary pressures and higher operating expenses widened its losses.

items.title: Marico profit falls 7%, declares 350% dividend
items.description: Marico Bangladesh Ltd reported a 7 percent year-on-year decline in profit for the first half of the current financial year, despite higher sales, as a significant increase in material prices weighed on earnings.

items.title: UCB reports progress in sustainable finance
items.description: United Commercial Bank PLC (UCB) has unveiled its third independent sustainability report, titled “Transforming Intent into Planetary Impact”, at a ceremony at its corporate office in Dhaka yesterday.

items.title: BRAC Bank’s nine-month profit jumps 38%
items.description: BRAC Bank’s net profit, including earnings from its subsidiaries, rose 38 percent year-on-year to Tk 2,121 crore in the first nine months of 2026, driven by higher revenue, deposit growth and improved operating efficiency.

items.title: FTA talks with Malaysia focus on trade, investment
items.description: The first round of Bangladesh-Malaysia FTA (free trade agreement) negotiations covered trade in goods and services, rules of origin, customs procedures, digital trade, and sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) measures.
